name: Plamia Istria
original_name: プラミア イストリア
source:
In the deep autumn forest.

Liza (heroine, name can be changed) wakes up in an unknown hut and is told by a young man who calls himself Oshin that he has lost his memory...?

A fairy-tale-style otherworld fantasy with the theme of [Autumn x Sickness] and the motif of the Russian folktale "Vasilisa the Watery."

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4610]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
深秋的森林里。

莉莎（女主角，名字可改）在一间不知名的小屋中醒来，一名自称阿信的年轻人告诉他他失去了记忆……？

以俄罗斯民间故事《水汪汪的瓦西里莎》为主题，以【秋天×疾病】为主题的童话风格的异世界奇幻作品。

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4610]NovelGame[/url]]
